long_description:
Dedalus Labs builds persistent compute for AI agents. Our flagship product, Dedalus Machines, gives agents isolated computers where they can run software, keep files and state, and do useful work over time.

We build across virtualization, distributed storage, networking, scheduling, and orchestration. Our goal is to make persistent compute dependable and straightforward to use through APIs and developer tools, so developers can build agents that work with real software and maintain a working environment across sessions.
name: Dedalus Labs
